ControlPropertyState.AutoRuleBindingString:
Switch(
    Key,
    "tasks", If(App.ActiveScreen <> scr_Tasks, Navigate(scr_Tasks, ScreenTransition.None)),
    "punches", If(App.ActiveScreen <> scr_Punches, Navigate(scr_Punches, ScreenTransition.None)),
    "home", If(App.ActiveScreen <> scr_Home, Navigate(scr_Home, ScreenTransition.None))
)

Rules.InvariantScript:
Switch(
    ThisItem.IconKey,

    "Home", Icon.Home,
	
    "Trending", Icon.Trending,
	
    "Document", Icon.Document,
	
    "Flag", Icon.Flag,

    "Message", Icon.Message,

    "Settings", Icon.Settings,

    "Lock", Icon.Lock,

    "Chart", Icon.TrendingUpwards,
	
	
    Icon.Home
)

With(
    {
        _key: Lower(Trim(Self.SelectedItemKey)),
        _hasProject: !IsBlank(varProjectId),
        _hasConfig: varProjectHasReportConfig || varHomeHiveLoaded || varProjectHasPHRData
    },
    If(
        _key <> "home" && !_hasProject,
        Notify("Please select a project first.", NotificationType.Warning);
        Set(varAppView, "Home");
        Navigate(scr_Home, ScreenTransition.None),
        Switch(
            _key,
            "home", Set(varAppView, "Home"); Navigate(scr_Home, ScreenTransition.None),
            "overview", Set(varAppView, "Overview"); Navigate(scr_Overview, ScreenTransition.None),
            "tasks", Set(varAppView, "Tasks"); Navigate(scr_Tasks, ScreenTransition.None),
            "punches", Set(varAppView, "Punches"); Navigate(scr_Punches, ScreenTransition.None),
            "briefing", Set(varAppView, "Briefing"); Navigate(scr_Briefing, ScreenTransition.None),
            "config", Set(varAppView, "Config"); Navigate(scr_Config_NEW, ScreenTransition.None),
            "superadmin", Set(varAppView, "SuperAdmin"); Navigate(scr_SuperAdmin, ScreenTransition.None),
            "skyline", Set(varAppView, "Skyline"); Navigate(scr_Skyline, ScreenTransition.None),
            Notify("Key not mapped: [" & _key & "]", NotificationType.Error)
        )
    )
)

Rules.InvariantScript: "Load the report tree, project scope and assigned forms before editing the configuration."
Notify("More configuration actions will be available here.", NotificationType.Information)
"Configure the report dictionary and assign forms to the selected node."
"①   Select a Header" & Char(10) & "Choose the top-level header"
"②   Select a Section" & Char(10) & "Choose a section under the header"
"③   Select a Subsection" & Char(10) & "Choose a subsection under the section"
"④   Assign Forms" & Char(10) & "Assign forms to the selected node"
"Select which punch templates and statuses are included in the Project Handover Report."
"Changes are saved immediately. Use Apply to Overview to regenerate the report snapshot."
"No punch templates found for this project."

If(
    !varConfigLoaded,
    "Load configuration data to start editing the report dictionary.",
    IsBlank(varSelectedNodeId),
    "Select a node from the report structure.",
    varSelectedNodeLevel <> 3,
    "Select a subsection to assign forms. Headers and sections are only used to organize the structure.",
    "Review assigned forms or assign new forms to this subsection."
)

ControlPropertyState.AutoRuleBindingString: "ⓘ  " & If(IsBlank(varSelectedNodeId), "Select a node from the report structure to view details and assign forms.", varSelectedNodeLevel <> 3, "Select a subsection to assign forms. Headers and sections are used only to organize the structure.", "Navigate the structure on the left and assign forms to the selected node.")

Rules.InvariantScript:
SortByColumns(
    Filter(
        colConfigTreeRows,
        IsBlank(txtConfigTreeSearch.Text) ||
        StartsWith(
            Lower(Text(RowLabel)),
            Lower(Text(txtConfigTreeSearch.Text))
        )
    ),
    "RowSortPath",
    SortOrder.Ascending
)

ControlPropertyState.AutoRuleBindingString:
SortByColumns(
    Filter(
        colNodes,
        IsActive &&
        (
            Len(Trim(Text(varTreeSearch))) = 0 ||
            StartsWith(Lower(Text(DisplayName)), Lower(Trim(Text(varTreeSearch))))
        )
    ),
    "LevelNo", SortOrder.Ascending,
    "SortOrder", SortOrder.Ascending,
    "DisplayName", SortOrder.Ascending
)

Rules.InvariantScript:
If(
    Text(ThisItem.RowNodeId) = Text(varSelectedNodeId),
    FontWeight.Semibold,
    Switch(
        Value(ThisItem.RowLevel),
        1, FontWeight.Semibold,
        FontWeight.Normal
    )
)

Switch(
    Value(ThisItem.RowLevel),
    1, Icon.Database,
    2, Icon.Folder,
    3, Icon.Document,
    Icon.Document
)

Switch(
    Value(ThisItem.RowLevel),
    1, varTheme_PulseBlueDark,
    2, ColorValue("#0EA5E9"),
    3, varTheme_TextMuted,
    varTheme_TextMuted
)
"✓  STATUS" & Char(10) & If(varCfg_ReadyForReview, "Ready for review", "Pending scope")
"📅  LAST UPDATED" & Char(10) & Text(Now(), "dd/mm/yyyy") & Char(10) & Text(Now(), "hh:mm AM/PM")
"📄  " & ThisItem.PhaseName & " • " & ThisItem.ElementDiscipline & " • " & ThisItem.ElementLevel & "        " & ThisItem.GroupKey & "        " & Text(ThisItem.Sct) & "        Assigned"
"No forms assigned to this node yet."
"You have moved forms between lists but have not saved the changes yet."
"Search forms by phase, discipline, level, form or group key..."

If(
    varScopeModalLoading,
    "Saving...",
    If(
        varScopeModalDirty,
        "Save changes",
        "No changes"
    )
)

ControlPropertyState.AutoRuleBindingString:
Notify(
    "Save backend will be wired in the next phase.",
    NotificationType.Warning
)

Rules.InvariantScript: "📄" & Char(10) & "No forms available" & Char(10) & "All available forms have already been assigned."

If(
    IsBlank(txtScopeModalSearch.Text),
    colScopeModalAvailable,
    Search(
        colScopeModalAvailable,
        txtScopeModalSearch.Text,
        PhaseName,
        ElementDiscipline,
        ElementLevel,
        FormName,
        FormDescription,
        GroupKey
    )
)

ControlPropertyState.AutoRuleBindingString:
Filter(
    colScopeModalAvailable,
    IsBlank(txtScopeModalSearch.Text) ||
    StartsWith(Lower(Text(PhaseName)), Lower(Text(txtScopeModalSearch.Text))) ||
    StartsWith(Lower(Text(ElementDiscipline)), Lower(Text(txtScopeModalSearch.Text))) ||
    StartsWith(Lower(Text(ElementLevel)), Lower(Text(txtScopeModalSearch.Text))) ||
    StartsWith(Lower(Text(FormName)), Lower(Text(txtScopeModalSearch.Text))) ||
    StartsWith(Lower(Text(FormDescription)), Lower(Text(txtScopeModalSearch.Text))) ||
    StartsWith(Lower(Text(GroupKey)), Lower(Text(txtScopeModalSearch.Text)))
)

Rules.InvariantScript:
If(
    CountIf(colScopeModalSelectedAvailable, GroupKey = ThisItem.GroupKey) > 0,
    varTheme_PulseSoft,
    Color.Transparent
)

If(
    CountIf(colScopeModalSelectedAvailable, GroupKey = ThisItem.GroupKey) > 0,
    RemoveIf(colScopeModalSelectedAvailable, GroupKey = ThisItem.GroupKey),
    Collect(colScopeModalSelectedAvailable, ThisItem)
)

If(
    CountIf(colScopeModalSelectedAvailable, GroupKey = ThisItem.GroupKey) = 0,
    Collect(colScopeModalSelectedAvailable, ThisItem)
)
"📄" & Char(10) & "No forms assigned" & Char(10) & "Move forms from Available to assign them."

If(
    IsBlank(txtScopeModalSearch.Text),
    colScopeModalAssigned,
    Search(
        colScopeModalAssigned,
        txtScopeModalSearch.Text,
        PhaseName,
        ElementDiscipline,
        ElementLevel,
        FormName,
        FormDescription,
        GroupKey
    )
)

ControlPropertyState.AutoRuleBindingString:
Filter(
    colScopeModalAssigned,
    IsBlank(txtScopeModalSearch.Text) ||
    StartsWith(Lower(Text(PhaseName)), Lower(Text(txtScopeModalSearch.Text))) ||
    StartsWith(Lower(Text(ElementDiscipline)), Lower(Text(txtScopeModalSearch.Text))) ||
    StartsWith(Lower(Text(ElementLevel)), Lower(Text(txtScopeModalSearch.Text))) ||
    StartsWith(Lower(Text(FormName)), Lower(Text(txtScopeModalSearch.Text))) ||
    StartsWith(Lower(Text(FormDescription)), Lower(Text(txtScopeModalSearch.Text))) ||
    StartsWith(Lower(Text(GroupKey)), Lower(Text(txtScopeModalSearch.Text)))
)

Rules.InvariantScript:
If(
    CountIf(colScopeModalSelectedAssigned, GroupKey = ThisItem.GroupKey) > 0,
    varTheme_PulseSoft,
    Color.Transparent
)

If(
    CountIf(colScopeModalSelectedAssigned, GroupKey = ThisItem.GroupKey) > 0,
    RemoveIf(colScopeModalSelectedAssigned, GroupKey = ThisItem.GroupKey),
    Collect(colScopeModalSelectedAssigned, ThisItem)
)

If(
    CountIf(colScopeModalSelectedAssigned, GroupKey = ThisItem.GroupKey) = 0,
    Collect(colScopeModalSelectedAssigned, ThisItem)
)

If(
    IsBlank(varProjectId),
    Notify("Please select a project first.", NotificationType.Warning);
    Exit()
);

Set(varCfgPunches_IsLoading, true);
Set(varCfgPunches_Error, "");

ClearCollect(
    colCfgPunchTemplates,
    FirstN(
        Table(
            {
                ProjectId: 0,
                TemplateId: 0,
                TemplateCode: "",
                TemplateName: "",
                TemplateDisplayName: "",
                TemplateIsActive: false,
                TemplateProjectIsActive: false,
                TemplateProjectClosed: false,
                CategoryCount: 0,
                CategoriesSummary: "",
                TemplateColorIndex: 0,
                TemplateChipBg: varTheme_SurfaceAlt,
                TemplateChipFg: varTheme_TextMuted,
                TotalPunches: 0,
                OpenPunches: 0,
                ClearedPunches: 0,
                ClosedPunches: 0,
                IsIncluded: false,
                DisplayOrder: 0,
                ConfigExists: false
            }
        ),
        0
    )
);

IfError(
    With(
        {
            resp: Warroom_GetProjectPunchTemplates.Run(Value(varProjectId))
        },
        ClearCollect(
            colCfgPunchTemplates,
            ForAll(
                Table(ParseJSON(Coalesce(resp.result, "[]"))),
                {
                    ProjectId: Value(Text(Value.ProjectId)),
                    TemplateId: Value(Text(Value.TemplateId)),
                    TemplateCode: Text(Value.TemplateCode),
                    TemplateName: Text(Value.TemplateName),
                    TemplateDisplayName: Text(Value.TemplateDisplayName),

                    TemplateIsActive:
                        Lower(Text(Value.TemplateIsActive)) = "true" ||
                        Text(Value.TemplateIsActive) = "1",

                    TemplateProjectIsActive:
                        Lower(Text(Value.TemplateProjectIsActive)) = "true" ||
                        Text(Value.TemplateProjectIsActive) = "1",

                    TemplateProjectClosed:
                        Lower(Text(Value.TemplateProjectClosed)) = "true" ||
                        Text(Value.TemplateProjectClosed) = "1",

                    CategoryCount:
                        If(
                            IsBlank(Text(Value.CategoryCount)) ||
                            Text(Value.CategoryCount) = "null",
                            0,
                            Value(Text(Value.CategoryCount))
                        ),

                    CategoriesSummary: Text(Value.CategoriesSummary),

                    TemplateColorIndex:
                        Mod(
                            If(
                                IsBlank(Text(Value.DisplayOrder)) ||
                                Text(Value.DisplayOrder) = "null",
                                1,
                                Value(Text(Value.DisplayOrder))
                            ) - 1,
                            6
                        ) + 1,

                    TemplateChipBg:
                        Switch(
                            Mod(
                                If(
                                    IsBlank(Text(Value.DisplayOrder)) ||
                                    Text(Value.DisplayOrder) = "null",
                                    1,
                                    Value(Text(Value.DisplayOrder))
                                ) - 1,
                                6
                            ) + 1,
                            1, varTheme_PulseSoft,
                            2, ColorValue("#EEF2FF"),
                            3, ColorValue("#ECFDF5"),
                            4, ColorValue("#FFF7ED"),
                            5, varTheme_SurfaceAlt,
                            6, ColorValue("#F8FAFC"),
                            varTheme_PulseSoft
                        ),

                    TemplateChipFg:
                        Switch(
                            Mod(
                                If(
                                    IsBlank(Text(Value.DisplayOrder)) ||
                                    Text(Value.DisplayOrder) = "null",
                                    1,
                                    Value(Text(Value.DisplayOrder))
                                ) - 1,
                                6
                            ) + 1,
                            1, varTheme_PulseBlueDark,
                            2, ColorValue("#2563EB"),
                            3, ColorValue("#059669"),
                            4, ColorValue("#EA580C"),
                            5, varTheme_TextMuted,
                            6, varTheme_TextMuted,
                            varTheme_PulseBlueDark
                        ),

                    TotalPunches:
                        If(
                            IsBlank(Text(Value.TotalPunches)) ||
                            Text(Value.TotalPunches) = "null",
                            0,
                            Value(Text(Value.TotalPunches))
                        ),

                    OpenPunches:
                        If(
                            IsBlank(Text(Value.OpenPunches)) ||
                            Text(Value.OpenPunches) = "null",
                            0,
                            Value(Text(Value.OpenPunches))
                        ),

                    ClearedPunches:
                        If(
                            IsBlank(Text(Value.ClearedPunches)) ||
                            Text(Value.ClearedPunches) = "null",
                            0,
                            Value(Text(Value.ClearedPunches))
                        ),

                    ClosedPunches:
                        If(
                            IsBlank(Text(Value.ClosedPunches)) ||
                            Text(Value.ClosedPunches) = "null",
                            0,
                            Value(Text(Value.ClosedPunches))
                        ),

                    IsIncluded:
                        Lower(Text(Value.IsIncluded)) = "true" ||
                        Text(Value.IsIncluded) = "1",

                    DisplayOrder:
                        If(
                            IsBlank(Text(Value.DisplayOrder)) ||
                            Text(Value.DisplayOrder) = "null",
                            0,
                            Value(Text(Value.DisplayOrder))
                        ),

                    ConfigExists:
                        Lower(Text(Value.ConfigExists)) = "true" ||
                        Text(Value.ConfigExists) = "1"
                }
            )
        )
    ),

    Set(varCfgPunches_Error, FirstError.Message);
    ClearCollect(
        colCfgPunchTemplates,
        FirstN(colCfgPunchTemplates, 0)
    )
);

If(
    !IsBlank(varCfgPunches_Error),
    Notify(
        "Punch templates could not be loaded: " & varCfgPunches_Error,
        NotificationType.Error
    )
);

Set(varCfgPunches_Loaded, true);
Set(varCfgPunches_IsLoading, false);
